Condition : 1 - Condition 21(1):

Details of biomass fuel source contracts shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, prior to the first occupation of any dwelling in the development. The source of the material shall be from the most sustainable source possible.
description: Details of on site sustainability in accordance with condition 21 of planning application 00657/P/P13 dated 1 July 2010 for 164 residential units, ancillary fitness suite and business centre, retail (Class A1 use) caf?/restaurant (Class A3 use) office (Class B1 use) and Public House (Class A4 use) together with access, public and private open space, basement car and cycle parking provision, public convenience, provision of a pontoon and use of arches 4 & 5 under Kew Bridge for boat club (Class D2 use)
